name: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited
summary: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar and alcohol in India. It operates through Sugar, Distillery, and Power segments. The company offers sugar by-products, such as molasses, bagasse, fly ash, and press mud; and bio-compost/bio-manure. It also generates and sells power to the Uttar Pradesh state grid. In addition, the company produces and sells industrial alcohol to alcohol-based chemical plants; and ethanol to oil companies. The company was formerly known as Bajaj Hindusthan Limited and changed its name to Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited in January 2015. The company was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Noida, India.
